coverage_claim: OPRA universe of U.S.-listed stock, ETF and index options; excludes futures and non-U.S. options; GTH and RTH included.
delivery: Daily files; historical grouping by day/month/year; intraday delivery requires separate contact.
mapping_caveat: IDs above are from the LiveVol mapping reproduced in the published paper; reconcile against Cboe's official XLSX before implementation.
limitations: No beneficial-owner or verified institutional/customer identity.
No separate quote-event timestamp; quote age cannot be measured from this file alone.
Legacy canceled_trade_condition_id is always zero; exact cancellation/replacement linkage unverified.
Optional IV/Greeks can default to zero when unavailable/invalid; zero must be treated as missing.
Underlying bid/ask can default to zero when unavailable.
Historical inactive/delisted underlying and adjusted-contract coverage not measured.
Business-use license and price not verified.
economic_interpretation: SLAN is a retail/wholesaler price-improvement-auction proxy, not investor identity. Published evidence attributes short-horizon underlying predictability in retail options flow more plausibly to intermediary hedging/price pressure than informed trading.
